name: Gmail Attachment Gallery
description: Collect attachments from selected Gmail conversations, including collapsed messages.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' blob:; connect-src https://gmail.googleapis.com https://oauth2.googleapis.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
